finding.headline: "The Combo-Feeder's Short List"
finding.problem: "I'm breastfeeding, topping with formula, and pumping at work. Every list is either all-breast or all-bottle. I'm buying duplicates. What's the actual minimum for all three?"
finding.person: Mum doing mixed feeding; every "essentials" list assumes one method; she needs the intersection without doubling up.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone (combo-feeding minimal setup).". Verdict: PASSES (4/5).
